name: Silver Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. To the north, a dimly lit shop stands, the sign
desc3: over the door reading "Curious Goods" in a spidery script. A large,
desc4: gaily decorated shop to the south sports a yellow awning. Its brightly
desc5: painted sign reads "General Store". Quite a few people mill about
desc6: here, entering the shops or heading west toward the town square.
desc7: Silver streets heads off to the east and west here.
